stem: Which statement best describes an interaction between the muscular system and the respiratory system?

options.label: A
options.text: The hormone adrenaline causes blood vessels to contract and send more blood to major muscles.

options.label: B
options.text: Metabolic wastes generated by muscle cells are eliminated in urine.

options.label: C
options.text: The diaphragm contracts causing the chest cavity to expand, which draws air into the lungs.

options.label: D
options.text: Nutrients absorbed in the small intestine are transported in blood to the brain.
